items.title: Delivery
Behind the Counter Score
Total Score
D1 - For security reasons, was courier and vehicle correct per by 3PO app?
D2 - Was courier polite, did they confirm their name and yours?
D3 - Was courier neatly presented and adhered to appropriate hygiene standards?
D5 -Was 'End to End' time from payment to courier present under 30 minutes?  Time begins on  payment and ends when order is presented
D6 - Was there a timing deviation between predicted app arrival time and actual arrival time?
D7 - Accuracy: Was order in correct packaging?
D8 -  Accuracy: Was pick ticket visible and order numbers written on every bag?

D9 - Accuracy:  Did you receive all the food and drink items as ordered, and were they properly 
prepared?
D10 -  Did you receive all the condiments (whether required or requested), along with utensils, napkins, and straws?
D 10 - Accuracy: Was ketchup included with your french fry order?
D11 - Quality: Was your sandwich/entrée served neat, at proper temperature, fresh, and did it taste good?
D12 - Quality: Were french fries at proper temperature and salted  -OR- hash browns at proper temperature and did they taste good?
D13 - Quality: Was your drink served neat, at the proper temperature and did it taste good?
D14 - Quality: Was your dessert/McCafé Bakery served neat, at the proper temperature, and did it taste good?
Tempering & Prep: Were product levels sufficient per posted product level charts/eProduction  monitor for the volume of business?
Tempering & Prep:  Were products correctly labeled and within secondary shelf lives?
MFY: Were UHC product holding times and holding levels being adhered to?
Fries/hash browns:  Were french fries/hash browns available to meet demand, following cooking and holding procedures and french fries station set up/maintained correctly?
Beverages and Desserts: Were drinks placed on appropriate cart/table identified? Were drinks placed separately, grouped by order and served correctly?

Order Assembly: Were orders assembled correctly, once all items were available, and checked 
for accuracy? Were Stations/Landing Tables utilized appropriately?
General Cleanliness Production and Service Areas: Did restaurant display general cleanliness in employee areas, without a negative impact on operations and safety?
People Positioning: Area employees positioned and adjustments made, as conditions dictate, throughout the shift?

Leading Operations: Shift and Area Leaders conduct travel paths, identify danger zones and  take appropriate actions to prioritize & reduce operational barriers to deliver Gold Standard  products and a great customer experience.
Operational Focus: Was the manager waware of the  restaurant's priorities, goals, and progress?
